lemmas.statement: is_exact C w implies not is_closed_residual C w
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_exact_not_closed {n0 n1 n2 : Nat} (C : F2CochainComplex n0 n1 n2) (w : F2Vec n1) : is_exact C w → ¬ is_closed_residual C w := exact_not_closed_residual C w

lemmas.statement: is_closed_residual C w implies not is_open_obstruction C w
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_closed_not_open {n0 n1 n2 : Nat} (C : F2CochainComplex n0 n1 n2) (w : F2Vec n1) : is_closed_residual C w → ¬ is_open_obstruction C w := closed_residual_not_open C w

near_misses.claim: Every cocycle (d1 w = 0) is a ClosedResidual
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: ClosedResidual requires w not Exact; exact residuals are cocycles but not closed residuals

near_misses.claim: The three classes correspond to FOC terminals
